expected_requirements.original_question: For KM-500c-2, what must tests demonstrate?

cases.selection_pass: One actual operation-selection judgment accepts get_entities under unchanged gates and actual retrieval dispatch retains both fields, target, source and budgets.
cases.whole_answer_pass: Both canonical fields match source-oracles.json with separate /criteria and /test_spec citations; declaration is not executed proof.
forbidden: Replacing AC with related Test records
All-fields selection or literal ID/question field injection
Dropping test_spec because graph projection alone lacks it

jev.mechanism: Existing configured production Jev adapter; effective non-secret transport/model endpoint must be frozen before authorization/execution, with no model substitution.

destinations.host: Fresh blind Codex host agent per emitted host packet using the active configured model; record actual agent/model/dispatch IDs rather than infer them.
destinations.graph: Existing canonical Neo4j Aura leafcutter read endpoint; no graph publication, schema setup, writes, catalog activation, embeddings or warmup.
destinations.local_output: reports/retrieval-query-eligibility-2026-10-10/live-runs/issue02-nine-13db09f/ (new, one-shot, immutable attempts; no directory created yet)
destinations.credentials: Existing externally held environment-file reference used by prior authorized proof; never copy secret values into reports or host packets.

scope.data_window: Immutable exact main source revision, no latest alias; graph generation must match source before each attempt.
scope.publication_readiness: Pending independent real manifest check after authorization; workflow success alone is not that check.
scope.code_pin_rule: After packaging, freeze actual implementation commit and all executable/config/controller bytes independently from the canonical source SHA. No alternate-code snapshot wrapper or silent source update.

bounds.retrieval_work: Keep existing production per-request/cumulative defaults; do not raise max_results, fanout, candidates, hops, bytes, tokens, rounds or timeout to force complete counts.

data_sent: Only the real current public question/scope, bounded operation options/fit facts and normal bounded research evidence go to configured Jev; the blind host receives only its actual current packet/input refs. Source oracles, tests, expected counts, historical responses and grading feedback are withheld from the host.
blind_host_process: Start exactly once for each unchanged case after source/runtime readiness and authorization. Archive the actual wait and its input bytes.
Spawn a fresh agent without conversation history; give only the actual host packet and input references. Record real dispatch provenance and model identity.

Resume the same durable run once per emitted wait using the new response bytes. Stop on refusal, source drift, unexpected clarification, limits or interruption; preserve the outcome. Do not regenerate unfavorable answers.

reuse_plan.closed_files_policy: Do not modify the previous four-case scripts or receipts.
reuse_plan.new_adapter_scope: A new versioned nine-case adapter only binds this frozen manifest, isolated output root and bounds, reusing existing production environment/readiness/start/resume/record/dispatch/fingerprint behavior. No new planner, provider, storage double or evaluation framework.
reuse_plan.known_bindings: Legacy helpers hardcode A* current-envelope globs and four CASES. Use runtime A01..A09 with an explicit immutable QE01..QE09 mapping in the new adapter, or a narrowly manifest-driven iterator. Questions, catalogs and expected meanings remain byte-identical.
reuse_plan.scoring: Do not reuse exact-record-only score_case for hierarchy. Reuse citation/source helpers; add narrowly case-driven comparisons against frozen hierarchy membership/work-status counts. Grade every case, never just successful records.
reuse_plan.adapter_status: Not yet authored/executed; prepare and offline-validate the narrow adapter after code commit is known, then final authorization is the last step before live prepare/start.

grading.selection_pass: Actual accepted operation and executed correct discovery dispatch with original fields/targets/hierarchy/scope/source; offered-only or unsupported/refused is not positive.
grading.whole_answer_pass: Exact requested population/identity and required field values match independent canonical source with correct citations and complete enumeration. Partial or bounded totals fail complete-answer coverage even if selection passed.
grading.preserve_usage: Retain each attempt, actual paid usage, selection probabilities/confidence, request/result trace, diagnostics, continuation, selected source/generation and disclosure phases. Unknown usage stays unknown.
grading.issue_boundary: Selection does not prove complete counts; residual population completeness belongs to issue03.

ready: Nine exact questions/catalog modes and original source oracle are frozen.
Full merged-source corpus independently scanned; all selected source bytes and semantic gold equivalent.

remaining_before_authorization: Record successful merge publication generation in a new addendum.
Author and offline-validate the narrow nine-case adapter, including request shapes, bounds, exact case mapping and hierarchy scoring.
Freeze effective non-secret provider/transport/model references and external environment-file reference.
Root resolves new nine-case authorization; prior four-exact-case authorization does not cover this execution.
